description:
You are working on a note-taking Android app called NotepadApp, which is currently open in Android Studio. The app needs a notification system for note reminders and app updates.

Add a complete notification infrastructure to the project:

1. Create a new file `NotificationHelper.kt` at `app/src/main/java/com/example/notepadapp/notifications/NotificationHelper.kt` containing:
   - Two channel ID constants: `CHANNEL_REMINDERS` = "note_reminders" and `CHANNEL_UPDATES` = "app_updates"
   - A method `createNotificationChannels(context: Context)` that creates two NotificationChannels:
     - "Note Reminders" channel with ID "note_reminders" and IMPORTANCE_HIGH
     - "App Updates" channel with ID "app_updates" and IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT
   - A method `buildReminderNotification(context: Context, title: String, content: String): Notification` that returns a notification built on the reminders channel using NotificationCompat.Builder with a small icon (use `android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info`), the given title, and content text.

2. Create `NotepadApplication.kt` at `app/src/main/java/com/example/notepadapp/NotepadApplication.kt` that:
   - Extends `android.app.Application`
   - Overrides `onCreate()` and calls `NotificationHelper.createNotificationChannels(this)`

3. Update `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`:
   - Add `android:name=".NotepadApplication"` to the `<application>` tag
   - Add `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />` before the `<application>` tag

4. Verify the project still builds by running Build > Make Project (or equivalent).

The project is located at `/home/ga/AndroidStudioProjects/NotepadApp/`.
